name: openmpi
description: The Open MPI Project is an open source Message Passing Interface implementation that is developed and maintained by a consortium of academic, research, and industry partners. Open MPI is therefore able to combine the expertise, technologies, and resources from all across the High Performance Computing community in order to build the best MPI library available. Open MPI offers advantages for system and software vendors, application developers and computer science researchers.
license: BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI AND mpich2 AND CECILL-B AND BSD-3-Clause

cma.description: Enable Linux Cross Memory Attach shared-memory transfers

cray-xpmem.description: Enable the installed Cray XPMEM SDK specified by OPENMPI_CRAY_XPMEM_ROOT (checked before generic XPMEM)

cuda.description: Enable CUDA-aware MPI using an installed CUDA Toolkit, found by the cuda port

fortran.description: Build MPI Fortran bindings using the target toolchain's Fortran compiler

ft.description: Enable MPI ULFM fault tolerance and embedded PRRTE fault-tolerance support

gpfs.description: Enable GPFS MPI-IO using the installed IBM Storage Scale SDK specified by OPENMPI_GPFS_ROOT

hcoll.description: Enable HCOLL collectives using an installed NVIDIA HPC-X SDK specified by OPENMPI_HCOLL_ROOT

ime.description: Enable IME MPI-IO using the installed DDN IME SDK specified by OPENMPI_IME_ROOT

knem.description: Enable KNEM shared-memory transfers (requires a compatible kernel module at runtime)

libltdl.description: Make libltdl available as an upstream fallback for dynamic loading without overriding native dlopen

libnl.description: Enable libnl3 netlink reachability components in Open MPI and embedded PRRTE

lsf.description: Enable IBM LSF scheduler integration using the installed SDK specified by OPENMPI_LSF_ROOT

lustre.description: Enable Lustre MPI-IO using matching target client development libraries specified by OPENMPI_LUSTRE_ROOT

munge.description: Enable PMIx MUNGE authentication (requires a configured MUNGE daemon at runtime)

ofi.description: Enable OFI transport using libfabric (providers depend on the libfabric build)

pbs.description: Enable PRRTE PBS allocation detection without linking the TM library

psm2.description: Enable PSM2 transport (requires Omni-Path hardware and an hfi1 driver at runtime)

rocm.description: Enable ROCm-aware MPI using the installed HIP SDK specified by OPENMPI_ROCM_ROOT

romio.description: Build the bundled ROMIO MPI-IO component (OMPIO is available without this feature)

sge.description: Enable PRRTE Sun/Univa Grid Engine allocation detection

slurm.description: Enable PRRTE Slurm launch and allocation detection (scheduler commands are required at runtime)

tm.description: Enable Torque/PBSPro TM launch support using the installed target SDK specified by OPENMPI_TM_ROOT

treematch.description: Build the bundled TreeMatch topology component

ucx.description: Enable Unified Communication X transports for MPI and OpenSHMEM

udreg.description: Enable Cray uDREG using the installed SDK specified by OPENMPI_UDREG_ROOT

ugni.description: Enable Cray uGNI using the installed SDK specified by OPENMPI_UGNI_ROOT

usnic.description: Enable the Cisco usNIC BTL through libfabric (requires its usNIC provider and hardware at runtime)

valgrind.description: Enable the Valgrind memchecker component and its buffer checks

xpmem.description: Enable XPMEM shared-memory transfers (requires a compatible kernel module at runtime)

zlibng.description: Enable PMIx native zlib-ng compression (requires ZLIB_COMPAT=OFF)
